scripts.build: npm run build -w @droptest/shared && npm run build -w @droptest/server && npm run build -w @droptest/client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true, force: true});"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @droptest/shared && npm run test -w @droptest/server
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('node_modules/@rollup/wasm-node/dist') && fs.existsSync('node_modules/rollup/dist')) { fs.cpSync('node_modules/@rollup/wasm-node/dist', 'node_modules/rollup/dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); }"
